204.description: NIC freed and unplugged on both ends

307.description: Creates a session and redirects to / or /login?error=forbidden
Creates a dev session and redirects to /
Redirects to the Authentik authorization endpoint

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only bookings ending after this unix timestamp.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only bookings starting before this unix timestamp.

parameters.name: switch_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one switch; omit for every port (peer picker / topology).

parameters.name: tofino_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one Tofino; omit for every port (peer picker).

has_password.description: The app password is write-only and never returned.

num_ports.description: Create-only: auto-generate this many front-panel ports named "1".."N".

numa_node.description: Negative values mean "no affinity" and are stored as null.

markdown.description:
A Markdown port table, or a whole tofino.md — the section named after
this Tofino wins.

unresolved.description: "Plugged into" values that matched no port or NIC and were kept as text.

mgmt_ip.description: Fill-gaps metadata for the switch itself (never overwrites a set value).

ports.description: Ports discovered on the switch, with their VLAN membership.

vlans.description: VLANs to upsert into the global database, by 802.1Q number.

peer_label.description: Display label of whatever this port is plugged into; empty when unplugged.

peer_nic_id.description: Set when cabled to a server NIC.

peer_port_id.description: Set when cabled to another management-switch port.

peer_server_id.description: Set when plugged into a whole server (no specific NIC), e.g. its IPMI port.

peer_text.description: Free-text peer, used when none of the structured peers is referenced.

peer_tofino_id.description: Set when cabled to a Tofino's management port.

mgmt_ip.description: Management IP or hostname; empty when not documented.

model.description: Vendor/model, e.g. "Aruba 6300M"; empty when not documented.

assignee_name.description: Free-form assignee for people or projects without an account.

oneOf.description: Structured cabling update. Omit to preserve the current link.

user_id.description: Authentik-backed user when one is available.

NicPeerInput.description:
What the server NIC is plugged into. Tofino-port and management-port links
are stored in the respective port maps and therefore appear from both
sides.

kind.description: "pf" for a physical function, "vf" for an SR-IOV virtual function.

numa_node.description: NUMA node; null when unknown or the NIC has no affinity.

peer_mgmt_port_id.description:
Management-switch port cabled to this NIC, derived from the management
port map (read-only mirror, edited from the management-switch side).

peer_nic_id.description: Server NIC cabled directly to this NIC.

peer_port_id.description: Tofino port cabled to this NIC, derived from the port map.

usage.description:
Who uses this NIC: the VM it is passed through to ("281 (kuppler-2)")
or a role such as "Management". Belongs to this NIC alone and is never
copied to the other end of a link.

oneOf.description:
A whole server, with no specific NIC/interface (e.g. its dedicated
IPMI/BMC port). Not mirrored — the server has no back-link.

PeerInput.description:
What a port is plugged into. `port`/`tofino` links are mirrored onto the
other end.

vlan_db_id.description: Row id in the global VLAN database.

enqueued.description: Number of queue rows (bookings × enabled calendars) enqueued.

cpu_model.description: e.g. "AMD EPYC 7443P 24-Core Processor"; empty when not documented.

memory_gb.description: Usable RAM in GiB, as the kernel reports it.

reservable.description: Whether regular users can reserve this whole server by the hour.

settings.description: All known settings as a key → value map.

peer_label.description:
Display label of whatever this port is plugged into ("Donnie 3/0",
"Pennywise 65.1", or the free text); empty when unplugged.

peer_nic_id.description: Set when this port is cabled to a server NIC.

peer_port_id.description: Set when this port is cabled to another Tofino port.

peer_text.description: Free-text peer, used when neither a port nor a NIC is referenced.

speed_gbps.description: Link speed in Gbit/s; 0 means "not documented".

mgmt_peer_label.description:
Management-switch port this Tofino's management port is cabled to,
e.g. "MgmtSwitch1 12"; null when unplugged. Read-only mirror, edited
from the management-switch port side.

app_password.description: Empty or missing keeps the stored password.

oneOf.description: Replaces the whole "plugged into" side when present.

vlans.description: Replaces the whole VLAN membership set when present.

cpu_model.description: Zero or negative numerics clear the field.
